timeline.label: Q1 2026 earnings: revenue $1.03B; EPS $1.60; operating income $195.3M
FY2025 10-K filed: revenue $4.07B (+8% YoY); net income $643.8M; OCF $783.8M
FY2024 10-K: revenue $3.77B; baseline for FY2025 growth comparison
Spin-off from Ingersoll Rand; Allegion becomes stand-alone public company focused on security products

industry.structure: Global mechanical and electronic security is an oligopoly of spec brands (Allegion, Assa Abloy, dormakaba) selling through distributors, locksmiths, and building-spec channels. Commercial projects drive volume; pricing and electronic attach support margins.
industry.share_shift: Allegion is gaining mix toward electronic access and software in Americas (high-single-digit non-res growth FY2025) while residential volumes softened. International remains lower-margin (~9% segment op margin vs ~28% Americas).
industry.trend: Building codes, retrofit electrification, and cloud access control are shifting mix from pure mechanical toward connected platforms; non-res construction cycles still dominate near-term volume.
